title: CCEA Approves 2 National Highway Projects in UP & Delhi (₹14,114.81 Crore Outlay)
summary: Clears Kanpur-Kabrai Greenfield Highway and 8.1 km Dwarka Expressway road tunnel.

blocks.content: Clears Kanpur-Kabrai Greenfield Highway and 8.1 km Dwarka Expressway road tunnel.

items: Kanpur-Kabrai Corridor: 117.7 km 4/6-lane access-controlled highway on NH-34 (₹7,145.14 cr on BOT Toll mode).
Delhi Road Tunnel: 8.1 km 6-lane tunnel connecting Dwarka Expressway (NH-248BB) to Nelson Mandela Marg (NH-148AE) in Vasant Kunj (₹6,969.67 cr on HAM mode).
